verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state approval is the sole gate before any agent-driven repo change ('Nothing runs until a person approves a contract... an agent is about to change your repository') and that decisions requiring human sign-off land in a single approvals list, even accessible from a phone. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the contract enforces scope boundaries strictly and can't be bypassed, and detail on what 'scope' fields the contract contains.
